title: 第25章 上官无悔的傲慢第26章 上官无悔跪地哀求陈灵儿暗生悔意
slug: 被逐出宗门后师尊师姐后悔终生
content_zh:
众人都屏住了呼吸，已经做好了嘲讽的准备！
唐七双臂抱胸，也摆出了一副看好戏的模样。
然而伴随着丹炉打开，异变陡然发生！
“轰！！”
唐七的丹云瞬间消散，像是遇到了什么可怕的东西。
“怎么可能？”
众人呆滞之间，苍穹之上龙蛇飞舞，大地裂开，涌出了地火！
“不！！”
刚才那人发出了绝望的喊声，直接被天劫扫中，化成了灰烬。
亵渎天劫，自然是要被针对的！
“真的是天雷地火！”
“七品丹药，他是七品丹药师啊！”
一些炼药宗师的声音都沙哑了，表情狰狞的看着周通，就像是看到了信仰！
电光交织之下，照亮了少年的半边脸庞，显得肃穆而庄严。
这一刻，再也没有人敢发出嘲弄之声。
周通用实力狠狠的打了所有人的脸。
“不可能，这绝对不是真的！”
唐七的脸色惨白到了极点，刚才他还是被众人追捧的新星，现在却沦为了可怜的陪衬。
七品对六品，这是降维般的碾压，根本不能相提并论！
片刻之后雷劫散去，菩提丹呈现在了众人的眼前。

所有人都信服了，这枚丹药可在七品当中称尊！
陈灵儿站在一旁，就像是被雷击中了，一颗心狠狠的跳动起来。
她死死的盯着周通，仿佛是第一天认识这个人。
不得不承认，少年沐浴在雷光中的身影已经悄然撬动了她的心扉。
“丹药已成，任务结算！”
周通毫不自傲，将丹药递到了罗毅的面前，但是对方的脸色却难看到了极点。
失算了！
他已经接到了莫流苏的嘱托，无论如何都要拖垮合欢宗，这样一来岂不是要功亏一篑？
“接下来，我还要炼制七品丹药！”
听到这话，罗毅陡然暴起，一脚踢碎了任务石碑。
“不好意思，这些任务也被撤销了！”
周通的瞳孔中立刻就渗出了寒意。
“连这些任务都没有了，那我们该怎么赚取功勋？”
龙凌云急问道。
“呵呵…那就只能等喽，一天没有任务那你们就等一天，一年没有那你们就等一年！”
此话一出，众人都恍然大悟，原来此人跟玉清宗是一伙的！
content_en:
Everyone held their breath and were ready to ridicule!
Tang Qi crossed his arms and looked like he was watching a good show.
However, as the alchemy furnace was opened, a sudden change occurred!
"Boom!!"
Tang Qi's pill cloud instantly dissipated, as if he had encountered something terrible.
"How is that possible?"
While everyone was stunned, dragons and snakes were flying in the sky, the earth cracked, and earth fire poured out!
"No!!"
The man who just let out a cry of despair was directly swept away by the tribulation and turned into ashes.
Those who blaspheme the calamity will naturally be targeted!
"It's really thunder and fire!"
"Seventh-grade elixir, he is a seventh-grade elixir master!"
The voices of some alchemy masters were hoarse, and they looked at Zhou Tong with ferocious expressions, as if they had seen Faith!
The interweaving of electric light illuminated half of the young man's face, making him look solemn and solemn.
At this moment, no one dared to make a mocking sound anymore.
Zhou Tong hit everyone hard in the face with his strength.
"No way, this is absolutely not true!"
Tang Qi's face was extremely pale. Just now he was a rising star being sought after by everyone, but now he was reduced to a pitiful foil.
Seventh-grade versus sixth-grade, this is a crushing like dimensionality reduction, and they cannot be compared at all!
After a while, the thunderstorm dispersed, and the Bodhi Pill appeared in front of everyone.
Everyone is convinced, this elixir can be respected among the seventh grade!
Chen Ling'er stood aside, as if she had been struck by lightning, her heart beating hard.
She stared at Zhou Tong as if it was the first day she met this person.
She had to admit that the young man's figure bathed in lightning had quietly moved her heart.
"The elixir is ready, the mission is over!"
Zhou Tong was not proud and handed the elixir to Luo Yi, but the other party's expression was extremely ugly.
Miscalculation!
He has received orders from Mo Liusu to bring down the Hehuan Sect no matter what. Wouldn't this mean that he would fail in his efforts?
"Next, I have to refine the seventh-grade elixir!"
Hearing this, Luo Yi suddenly got angry and kicked the mission stone into pieces.
"Sorry, these tasks have also been cancelled!"
Zhou Tong's pupils immediately seeped chills.
"Even these tasks are gone, so how can we earn merit?"
Long Lingyun asked anxiously.
"Haha...Then you can only wait. If there is no mission for one day, then you have to wait for one day. If there is no mission for one year, then you have to wait for one year!"
As soon as these words came out, everyone suddenly realized that this person was in the same group as the Yuqing Sect!
